```{r}
engineer <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      # Convert percentages
      across(
        c(starts_with("src_"), starts_with("pct_"),
          January:December),
        ~ as.numeric(str_remove(., "%")) / 100
      ),
      # Create base features
      yearMin = as.numeric(na_if(yearMin, "?")),
      product_age = 2023 - yearMin,
      Q1Sales = January + February + March,
      Q4Sales = October + November + December,
      high_season = if_else(Q4Sales > 0.5, 1, 0),
      is_variant = if_else(`Listing Type` == "variant", 1, 0),
      product_complexity = `Number of Components` * `Unit Weight (pounds)`,
      direct_sales_ratio = `pct_Direct Sales`,
      stock_orders_pct = `pct_Orders for Stock`,
      web_sales_dominant = if_else(src_www > 0.5, 1, 0),
      mobile_sales_dominant = if_else((src_iphone + src_android + src_ipad) > 0.5, 1, 0),
      platform_diversity = rowSums(across(starts_with("src_")) > 0.1)
    ) %>%
    select(
      direct_sales_ratio, stock_orders_pct,
      Q1Sales, Q4Sales, high_season,
      is_variant, product_age, product_complexity,
      web_sales_dominant, mobile_sales_dominant,
      platform_diversity
    )
}
```
